messages:
ops_lead: Postmortem posted for INC-2027 — follow-ups and runbook/playbook updates needed. TL;DR: recurring KV cache evictions during burst encode jobs caused latency spikes. Link: https://redwood.in/p/INC-2027. Need owners for remediation items, runbook triage steps, and an oncall checklist. Proposing: @maria runbook edits, @ajay autoscaler tuning, @sasha alerting. Ack and ETA?

maria: Ack. I can take the runbook edits. Will add explicit triage commands, escalation path, and a short checklist. ETA: EOD Tue.

ajay: I'll own autoscaler tuning and headroom analysis. Will capture metrics + repro steps and open a PR for canary changes by Fri.

sasha: I'll add alert thresholds and a rolling aggregation to reduce noise. Also will add a recurring query to detect the incident pattern weekly.

devon: FYI I put a quick triage snippet in the temp playbook, @maria can you review?

```bash
# quick triage - check runtime evictions and redis usage
kubectl logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i eviction
redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
curl -sS 'http://metrics.local/api/v1/query?query=rate(redis_memory_used_bytes[5m])'
```

maria: Nice, will integrate that. Also adding an explicit escalation step: if fallback not available run `POST /v1/deployments/fallback` and notify oncall.

sam: I can own automation for cache warmup before scheduled bursts. Will open a task and prototype a small pre-warm job.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027 closed by ops_lead. Postmortem published and follow-up reminders created for owners.

ops_lead: Created a parent Jira ticket INC-2027-FW for tracking: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2027-FW. Please add your sub-tasks and link PRs. I want weekly progress updates until all items are done.

kelly: Added owners in the Jira ticket and linked the PR template. Suggest the runbook add a clear threshold: "If eviction_rate > 0.5% over 5m AND p50 latency > 300ms, escalate to oncall@redwood.ai and trigger fallback."

maria: Confirmed, I'll add that threshold and a one-click checklist for oncall (commands, escalation message, rollback steps). Will include a small diagram for the escalation path.

ajay: Noted there's a recurrence pattern — I found similar traces in three prior incidents. I'll add a cross-incident note in the playbook to always check autoscaler headroom and model variant fallbacks.

ops_lead: Great. I'll review the runbook PR when it's up. Check-in scheduled for next Wed standup — please update progress in Jira before then. Tag this thread when you push PRs so we can follow. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sasha: ack :thumbsup:

maria: tagging when PRs are live.

sam: opened task INC-2027-FW-3 for cache warmup prototype and linked it to parent ticket.

ops_lead: Thanks everyone — let's keep this tight, recurring patterns are the costliest.
